name: Interaction with AMSI Provider Configuration
description: An interaction was detected with registry keys that control the Antimalware Scan Interface (AMSI). This feature is critical for detecting attempts to disable script-based threat detection before executing malicious code.

action.description: A process attempted to modify or delete a key related to AMSI configuration. This is a common defense evasion technique.

operational_usage: This is a significant feature. The 'AmsiEnable' value is often set to '0' to disable it. Any non-GPO or non-admin tool process touching these keys is highly suspicious. SIEM should correlate this with subsequent script execution events.
false_positive: Legitimate security configuration changes by administrators or Group Policy updates may trigger this. Baselining is essential.
